Part 1 • Câu 1/3 00:25

Bấm "Bắt đầu ghi âm" ở khung bên dưới để thu lại câu trả lời của bạn trong phiên thi thử.

Part 1 • Phỏng vấn khởi động (4–5 phút)

So sánh cùng 1 câu trả lời Speaking: Band 5.0 → 6.5 → 8.5+

Band 5.0 (Quá cụt, lặp từ): "Yes, I like coffee. I go to café every weekend. It is very nice and cheap."
Band 6.5 (Có mở rộng lý do): "Yes, I really enjoy visiting cafés on weekends because the quiet atmosphere helps me focus on reading and catching up with friends."
Band 8.5+ (Tự nhiên, idiomatic, mạch lạc): "Definitely — I’m a bit of a coffee enthusiast, so unwinding at a cozy neighborhood café has become my go-to weekend ritual. What draws me in isn’t just the caffeine boost, but the gentle background hum that somehow makes studying feel far less daunting."
